verdict.rationale: Check documents API creation of employees (Postman guide) and an official MCP server and toolsets that let agents manage employees, so an agent can drive part of onboarding. Tax and withholding setup is shown mainly through the embedded, human-facing Onboard Component rather than as agent-callable API steps, and compensation setup is not documented at all. missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoints for compensation or pay-rate setup, agent-driven withholding/W-4 tax setup via API, an end-to-end agent onboarding walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration.
